wiki.title: Trey Caldwell (politician)
wiki.extract: Hurchel "Trey" E. Caldwell III (born December 24, 1988) is an American politician serving as a member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives from the 63rd district. He was elected in November 2018, and assumed office on January 14, 2019. He is of Choctaw descent.
